_help: Edit this file, then run `npm run sync` to copy it into site/index.html. Anything in [BRACKETS] is a placeholder: a country can't take orders until its fx_from_aud and freight are real numbers. fx_from_aud converts the AUD prices in products.json into this country's currency. rounding is the step prices are rounded to after conversion (1 = whole units, 0.01 = cents). Freight amounts are in the country's own currency. example_freight is only used for sandbox testing (AIRWALLEX_ENV=demo) and is never charged in production.
